title: African American Woman Receiving Award, 1969 Banquet B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A formal ceremony snapshot stamped June 1969, depicting an older gentleman in a dark suit presenting a framed certificate or recognition award to an elegant African American woman. The recipient is dressed in a chic sleeveless outfit featuring a dark floral lace overlay, a corsage, a beaded necklace, and a high updo. In the background, other guests are seated at a banquet table against pleated curtain drapes.
